name: Seffa
description: Steamed vermicelli or couscous dusted with powdered sugar, cinnamon, and fried almonds as a sweet course.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
a generous spoonful of preserved lemon
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the couscous and ground ginger until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the dried apricots with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 30 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
